title: 965. Triples With Bitwise AND Equal To Zero

examples.explanation: Twelve ordered index triples have a combined bitwise AND of zero.
Every one of the 3*3*3 triples qualifies because 0 AND 0 AND 0 is 0.

hints: Precompute frequencies of all pairwise AND results; there are at most 2^16 distinct values.
For each pair value p and each element x, the triple qualifies exactly when (p AND x) == 0.
Multiply pair frequencies by matching third elements instead of enumerating all n^3 triples.
